findings.detail: The ticket is explicitly marked as a DUPLICATE of bug 6a81 ('recheck-review should accept a bugfix-size-attestation block once the ticket carries a current plan-review attestation'), which is still in_progress. A comment on 6a81 from RebarBotNava (2026-08-05) records: 'A signed COMPLETION_VERDICT of FAIL is on record at sha 45522963 from ~20h ago with two HIGH findings... To close: add those assertions and re-run verification, or record an evidence comment justifying the gap.' The primary fix for the reported defect has not been completed — 6a81 remains open with outstanding FAIL findings. The bug described in this ticket (a stale LLM-Review -1 cannot be cleared without a code change) is therefore not resolved.
findings.remediation: Resolve bug 6a81 (the primary fix ticket) by addressing the two HIGH findings identified in its FAIL verdict, then re-verify this ticket once 6a81 is closed with a PASS verdict.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[operator-attested]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify.
